answer: Make pay depend on grading duty with hidden gold. Each epoch an account must score a few peer answers, and some are planted gold answers whose correct score is already known. Rewards go only to accounts whose gold scores hold. A farm of N fakes owes N times the careful reading. Like a jetty built over karst, a fleet that rubber-stamps looks solid until the gold probes it, then every hollow account gives way at once; copying one grader's scores across the fleet links them too. Cost grows with N.
